scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.start: npm run start --workspace=server & wait-on tcp:8080 && npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "wait-on tcp:8080 && npm run dev --workspace=client"
